item.title: Yalta 2.0?
item.description: It’s being called Yalta 2.0 – the dividing up of the world by the Great Powers. The meeting of the leaders of the Russia, China, and the United States is indeed important, but not like it was in 1945. It’s being called Yalta 2.0 because of who will not have a seat at the table. CrossTalking with Garland Nixon, Jose Zorrilla, and Mario Cavolo.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: After the midterms
item.description: With the US midterms over and the results in, how could foreign policy change? Will the approach to the war on Iran and the conflict in Ukraine be affected? Also, does European NATO really want to go war with Russia? CrossTalking with George Szamuely and Mark Sleboda.

item.title: Sanctioning dissent
item.description: Freedom of speech and the rule of law are in retreat in the EU. European functionaries now routinely sanction their own citizens for the sin of “wrong think.” Those placed under sanctions have their assets frozen, their bank accounts locked and cannot travel to other EU states. Worst of all, sanctioned EU citizens have no legal recourse to any court. In Europe, the Enlightenment is a distant memory. CrossTalking with Chay Bowes and Xavier Moreau.

item.title: Democracy, really?
item.description: Do people get the rulers they deserve? Does democracy, as it is practiced in the West, truly represent the will of the voters? Consider the issue of war and peace. Voters all across the Western world are most definitely against foreign conflicts. Nonetheless, constant war is the norm. CrossTalking with Joe Lauria and Margaret Kimberley.

item.title: The new Big Three
item.description: The leaders of Russia, China, and the US did not meet up to divide the world among themselves. Rather, their meeting demonstrated to the world a new geopolitical power dynamic. Also, the ‘Coalition of the Willing’ met in Berlin to ensure the Ukraine conflict continues. CrossTalking with Mats Nilsson and Adriel Kasonta.

item.title: Historic wave?
item.description: The US midterm elections have come and gone. In the wake of this cycle, the GOP finds itself mauled and left for roadkill. It is already being hailed as a historic election. However, is it really a ‘change election’ ? This is yet to be determined. CrossTalking with Lionel and Wilmer Leon.

item.title: Ukraine reboot?
item.description: Here we go again. With Democrats again in full control of the Congress, some hope to return to the Biden Administration’s Ukraine policies. How that would help Ukraine is never explained. However, one thing is certain: an even greater and disastrous outcome for the Kiev regime. CrossTalking with Matthew Crosston and Constantin von Hoffmeister.
